summary: Verified all 5 acceptance criteria. The standalone black-box harness (mcp-acceptance/harness.js) targets a configurable production URL, reuses only the slice1-lab initialize fixture shape, deterministically records the initialize response, and correctly exits 1 against the current production component (initialize -> HTTP 400 / -32601) as the intentional Phase 0.1 baseline; verify.js confirms both the FAIL (exit 1) and PASS (exit 0) paths.
follow_up: Minor: the deterministic record includes the per-request Cloudflare cf-ray header (not in the harness volatile-header strip list), so byte-identical records across repeated runs against the same live endpoint are not guaranteed; the serialization itself (sorted keys, stable JSON) is deterministic. Not a defect against the acceptance criteria.
important_context: The harness is the regression gate and stays red (exit 1) until the production component implements a standards-compatible initialize handshake; Phase 2 (mcp-rmcp-gateway) must fix this.
Current production component (mcp-server/src/gateway.rs) only recognizes tools/list and tools/call; initialize returns HTTP 400 with JSON-RPC -32601 'Method not found'.
Harness default target URL is https://mcal.hajnal.space/mcp; override with MCP_URL or --url.
No production code was modified during verification; the mcp-acceptance/ directory is new/untracked.
